C0504.title: Tianjin Police Dismantle Virtual Device Operation Aiding Overseas Telecom Fraud Ring
C0504.summary: In July 2026, the Xiqing branch of the Tianjin public security bureau, relying on multi-unit coordinated operations and cross-province investigation, captured two suspects surnamed Wei and An who had illegally set up VOIP equipment. Investigations found the two had illegally installed three VOIP devices and occupied 16 landline circuits; overseas scammers dialed in remotely through the VOIP devices, so that victims' phones showed domestic landline numbers, lowering their vigilance and aiding overseas telecom fraud rings. The two have been placed under criminal coercive measures.
